description: BC Wildfire PSTA Head Fire Intensity is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by BC Wildfire Service. Provincial Strategic Threat Analysis (PSTA) is designed to consistently assess and map potential wildfire threats to values across the landscape (including communities, infrastructure and natural resources) and to integrate different aspects of wildfire hazard and risk. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher BC Wildfire Service. Its tags are BCWS, Fire, Head Fire Intensity, PSTA, Prevention. It offers 5 resource(s) in FGDB, KML, MULTIPLE, OTHER, WMS. The portal shows 2026-08-05 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
